pairs.description: Cranberry products may interact with warfarin, leading to elevated international normalized ratio (INR) values and increased bleeding complications.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of CYP2C9-mediated metabolism of S-warfarin by cranberry flavonoids and polyphenolic compounds.

pairs.description: High-dose cranberry consumption may alter the intestinal absorption and systemic exposure of lipophilic statins like atorvastatin.
pairs.mechanism: Weak modulation of organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP) and intestinal CYP3A4 by cranberry components.

pairs.description: Cranberry juice may slightly alter urinary acidification and tubular reabsorption kinetics of beta-lactam antibiotics such as amoxicillin.
pairs.mechanism: Urinary acidification altering renal clearance and passive non-ionic reabsorption kinetics of urinary excreted antibiotics.
